memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason for visit: hypertension and anxiety follow-up.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Mr reports occasional headaches and mild palpitations; feels nervous most days.
EXAMINATION: BP 148/92 mmHg, pulse 78, weight 82 kg, height 1.70 m, BMI 28.4 (obese). Advised on low‑salt diet and daily walking.
IMPRESSION: Uncontrolled hypertension; generalised anxiety disorder; osteoporosis risk.
ARRANGEMENTS: Start amlodipine 5 mg OD, telmisartan 40 mg OD, escitalopram 5 mg OD, buspirone 5 mg BD, alendronate 70 mg weekly, calcium 500 mg BD with vitamin D3. Order fasting lipid profile, fasting blood sugar, serum creatinine/eGFR, potassium, TSH, haemoglobin. Return if chest pain, breathlessness, fever >39°C, or bloody stools.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
amlodipine 5 mg OD
 telmisartan 40 mg OD
 escitalopram 5 mg OD
 buspirone 5 mg BD
 alendronate 70 mg once weekly
 calcium 500 mg BD with vitamin D3

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Fasting lipid profile: Cholesterol 210 mg/dL (<200 desirable), HDL 38 mg/dL (>40 desirable), LDL 130 mg/dL (<100 optimal), triglycerides 165 mg/dL (<150 normal).
Fasting blood sugar: 92 mg/dL (70‑99 normal).
Serum creatinine: 1.0 mg/dL (0.6‑1.2), eGFR 78 mL/min/1.73m2 (>60 normal).
Serum potassium: 4.3 mmol/L (3.5‑5.0).
TSH: 2.1 µIU/mL (0.4‑4.0).
Haemoglobin: 14.2 g/dL (13.0‑17.0).

memories.author: D03
memories.text: ECG: Sinus rhythm, rate 76 bpm. No ST‑T changes. Left ventricular voltage within normal limits. No pathological Q waves. Overall normal ECG.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason for visit: routine check‑up.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Denies headaches; occasional mild anxiety.
EXAMINATION: BP 138/86 mmHg, weight 81.5 kg, BMI 28.2 (obese). Advised to continue diet and activity.
IMPRESSION: Hypertension improving; anxiety controlled; lipids borderline high.
ARRANGEMENTS: Increase amlodipine to 5 mg BD. Continue other meds. Repeat lipid profile and renal panel in 6 weeks. Return if chest pain, palpitations, severe anxiety, or swelling of legs.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
amlodipine 5 mg BD
 telmisartan 40 mg OD
 escitalopram 5 mg OD
 buspirone 5 mg BD
 alendronate 70 mg once weekly
 calcium 500 mg BD with vitamin D3

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I’ve been feeling restless at night and worry about traffic. My mind races when I try to sleep.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason for visit: autumn review and influenza vaccine.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Reports better sleep, less worry.
EXAMINATION: BP 132/80 mmHg, weight 81 kg, BMI 28.0 (obese). Advised on diet and activity.
IMPRESSION: Hypertension at target; anxiety mild; osteoporosis prophylaxis ongoing.
ARRANGEMENTS: Give influenza vaccine today (05‑Nov‑2025). Continue current meds. Check lipids and renal function in 3 months. Return if fever >39°C, shortness of breath, chest pain, or unexplained bruising.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
DEXA scan (lumbar spine): T‑score –2.4 at L1‑L4. Hip T‑score –2.1. Diagnosis: osteoporosis.
FRAX 10‑yr major osteoporotic fracture risk 18% (without BMD).

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Serum calcium: 9.4 mg/dL (8.5‑10.5).
Serum 25‑OH vitamin D: 22 ng/mL (30‑100 sufficient).
Serum creatinine: 1.0 mg/dL, eGFR 77 mL/min/1.73m2.
Serum potassium: 4.4 mmol/L.

memories.author: D03
memories.text: Referral to Dr S. Rao, Endocrinology, Vikram Hospital, for osteoporosis management considering low vitamin D and persistent low BMD despite alendronate. Please advise on further therapy and supplementation.

memories.author: D03
memories.text: Letter from Dr S. Rao: Vitamin D deficiency confirmed. Recommend cholecalciferol 60,000 IU weekly for 8 weeks then maintenance 2000 IU daily. Continue alendronate. Repeat DEXA in 12 months. No need for anabolic agent at present.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason for visit: post‑referral review.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Denies new symptoms; takes vitamin D as prescribed.
EXAMINATION: BP 130/78 mmHg, weight 80.5 kg, BMI 27.9 (overweight). Advised on continued activity.
IMPRESSION: Hypertension well controlled; anxiety stable; osteoporosis managed with vitamin D repletion.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue amlodipine 5 mg BD, telmisartan 40 mg OD, escitalopram 5 mg OD, buspirone 5 mg BD, alendronate 70 mg weekly, calcium 500 mg BD with vitamin D3, cholecalciferol 2000 IU daily. Review lipids and renal panel in 4 months. Return if chest pain, palpitations, severe sadness, or unexplained fractures.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Appointment booked for 02‑Aug‑2026 at 10:30 AM with Dr Priya Natarajan (D03) for routine follow‑up.
